name: Excessive accent-color usage
summary: Limit the accent to brand identity, the primary action of a view and meaningful state; use neutrals for everything else.
problem: Emerald headings, links, nav, charts, tags and three primary buttons at once leave nothing that stands out. Colour no longer communicates.

bad.description: A panel where the title, nav, chart, three buttons and a tag are all emerald.

good.title: Neutral by default, accent by meaning
good.description: Neutral tabs and chart, one primary button, secondary and ghost buttons, and emerald only on the positive delta.

why: If removing a colour does not reduce comprehension, it was decoration. Scarcity makes the accent useful.
exceptions: A brand-led marketing page may use the accent more freely when the brand requires it.
Data visualisation may use hue to encode categories when neutrals cannot tell series apart.

humanReview: Is exactly one action per view emphasised?
Would the view lose meaning if the accent were removed?
